# Packages and Data

First, load the packages we'll need.

```{r packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse) 
library(usethis)
```

Then, read the data from the provided data file.

```{r}
datasaurus_dozen <- read_csv(
  "datasaurus_dozen.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    dataset = col_factor(),
    x = col_double(),
    y = col_double()
  )
)
# Note: this file was initially created using:
# write_csv(datasauRus::datasaurus_dozen, "datasaurus_dozen.csv")
```
